# OMe Games

> Independent mobile game studio creating Android games. Official website: https://ome-games.github.io/

## Games
- [DeadBlitz X: Zombie Survival](https://ome-games.github.io/games/deadblitz-x.html): 2D top-down Android zombie survival shooter with waves, weapon upgrades, unlockable survivors and boss encounters. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aistudio.zombiesurvival.vkmzla).
- [Archibrix: Block Builder](https://ome-games.github.io/games/archibrix.html): mobile block-building puzzles featuring architecture-inspired structures and Free Build mode. Refer to official game page for current store availability.

Promotional illustrations are conceptual artwork and may not match actual gameplay. Store availability and network requirements should be verified in current listings.

Archibrix Free Build includes active flood, rain, wind, earthquake and weight tests. These are in-game simulations.
- [Building test guide](https://ome-games.github.io/guides/building-stability-tests.html)
